answer: Treat each verified identity as one vertex in the trust graph by collapsing every external key an operator controls into a single linked vault: one entity, one jury seat, one vote. A sybil swarm then stops looking like a wide field and reads as a plume rising from one source, many near-identical nodes that co-sit and co-agree far more than independent peers would. Slash that excess concordance only when it persists across randomly dealt panels, so an honest lone node standing apart like a dune on open sand is never punished merely for agreeing.
